name: Google Ads
label: Google Ads API v25 — GAQL search, mutate, conversions
description: Official Google Ads API v25 REST at https://googleads.googleapis.com/v25. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth: OAuth access token as Bearer (customer supplies a current token). extraHeaders send developer-token from config developerToken and login-customer-id from config loginCustomerId (blank MCC id omitted). Reads use GAQL via GoogleAdsService.Search / SearchStream. No official push webhook; trigger.listen is omitted. Customer owns the Google Ads / MCC accounts. Never log developer-token, OAuth secrets, emails, or GCLIDs.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Search ops require GAQL in query (allowlist FROM campaign, ad_group, ad_group_ad, customer). Do not put access_token or developerToken here. Example: {"operation":"campaign.list","customerId":"1234567890","query":"SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name FROM campaign"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'customer.list' | 'campaign.get' | 'campaign.list' | 'campaign.mutate' | 'adGroup.list' | 'ad.list' | 'report.query' | 'conversion.upload' | 'audience.mutate'. No trigger.listen.

schema.label: customerId
schema.description: Target 10-digit customer id (no dashes). Required on all ops except customer.list. Falls back to config.

schema.label: campaignId
schema.description: Campaign resource id for campaign.get (Google Ads has no Get RPC; use to build GAQL WHERE campaign.id = …). Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: query
schema.description: GAQL for campaign.get/list, adGroup.list, ad.list, report.query. Google Ads has no Get RPC, so campaign.get must filter by id in the query. Example (list): SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name FROM campaign. Example (get): SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status FROM campaign WHERE campaign.id = 1234567890.

schema.label: operations
schema.description: Google Ads mutate operations list (campaign.mutate, audience.mutate). Official operations[].

schema.label: conversions
schema.description: uploadClickConversions conversions [{gclid, conversionAction, conversionDateTime, conversionValue, currencyCode}].

schema.label: partialFailure
schema.description: Allow mixed success on mutate / conversion.upload. Recommended true for uploads.

schema.label: pageSize
schema.description: Search page size. SearchStream may ignore.

schema.label: validateOnly
schema.description: When true, campaign.mutate / conversion.upload / audience.mutate validate without executing.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (GoogleAdsRow JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. No trigger.listen (Google Ads has no official campaign webhook).

configurationParameters.label: OAuth access token
configurationParameters.description: Google OAuth access token (StudioQuack secret). Scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Customer supplies a current token (engine does not refresh). Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Developer token
configurationParameters.description: Google Ads API Center developer-token (22-char). Sent as header developer-token on every call. Optional after the 2026-09-09 sunset (servers ignore it); still accepted. Test tokens cannot touch production accounts.

configurationParameters.label: Login customer id
configurationParameters.description: MCC manager id for header login-customer-id (10-digit, no dashes). Sent when set; omitted when blank.

configurationParameters.label: Customer id
configurationParameters.description: Default 10-digit target customer id when INPUT omits customerId.

configurationParameters.label: Campaign Id
configurationParameters.description: Default campaign id for campaign.get when INPUT omits campaignId. Example: 1234567890.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 60 (searchStream). Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
